versions.changelog:
AlphaEar Logic Visualizer v1.0.0 – initial release

- Turn finance or investment logic into visual diagrams, including transmission chains, thesis maps, and causal loops.
- Outputs Draw.io-compatible mxGraph XML or HTML diagram artifacts.
- Supports color-coded node impacts and clear layouts suited to logic type.
- Includes checks for input completeness and handles unclear cases with follow-up clarification.
- Explains and validates diagram structure in responses.
